1.TITLE: Does the trial have an expiry date?
1.TEXT: Today it does not expire automatically. It includes the limits shown here; it does not mean unlimited usage.

2.TITLE: Do I need a card to start?
2.TEXT: You do not need a card to continue with the trial.

3.TITLE: Can I purchase a paid plan now?
3.TEXT: Not yet. Plans marked as unavailable cannot be purchased. There is no confirmed date.

4.TITLE: What happens if I use all my AI responses?
4.TEXT: The assistant stops responding when the allowance is exhausted. You can access the dashboard and review usage in Billing; you cannot upgrade your plan here today.
